recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast composition featuring a black ink bottle tipped on its side, spilling a puddle that contains a grid of calendar numbers instead of liquid. The entire scene is set against a vast, off-white negative space with bold, geometric typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The ink bottle acts as the source for the surreal calendar puddle.
The top red-on-black block balances the heavy black text at the bottom.
The central subject is isolated by extreme negative space to emphasize the conceptual spill.
coreInvariants: Surrealist substitution of liquid with printed data
High-contrast black and white photography for the object

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The ink bottle and spill are positioned in the lower-middle third, scaled to occupy about 25% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black rectangular block at the top center serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top red text, drops to the ink bottle, follows the spill to the left, and finally rests on the bottom title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive, occupying roughly 70% of the canvas to create a clean, clinical atmosphere.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the bottle, top block, and bottom text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary display text at the top.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the background and the black elements; low saturation except for the single red accent.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Top text is vertically stacked for the secondary word and horizontally for the primary word within a black box.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stark contrast between a rigid geometric header and a slightly softer, more legible footer.
graphicDevices: Black rectangular container for top text
Surrealist collage element (calendar numbers inside liquid shape)

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and industrial feel of the bottom text.
Matches the geometric nature of the top display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a black ink bottle tipped on its side on an off-white surface. The spill should be a flat, matte-grey puddle shape containing a grid of black calendar numbers (23, 24, 25, etc.) in a sans-serif font. Ensure vast empty space above and below the object.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid black rectangle at the top center. Inside, place bold red geometric sans-serif text. At the bottom center, place a single word in bold black sans-serif followed by a period.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent off-white?
Does the spill contain calendar numbers instead of liquid?
Is the top text red inside a black box?

adjustableVariables: Content of the spill (e.g., letters instead of numbers)
Object being tipped (e.g., paint tube instead of ink bottle)
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text
Specific label text on the ink bottle

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphic elements
High-quality photographic texture on the bottle
Balanced distribution of weight between top and bottom

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the calendar numbers are legible within the spill.
Verify the red color is vibrant and not muted.
Check that the composition feels centered and intentional.
Confirm the background is free of distracting artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surreal Object Spill] + [Extreme Negative Space] + [Geometric Sans-Serif Typography] + [High Contrast B&W Photography with One Accent Color].
